configurations.description: VehicleRegistrationQuery -- QVRQ.P (plate + type + year), QVRQ.V (VIN). Synthetic suffixes: metadata declares QVRQ for both alternatives. Plate>VIN guardrail on the VIN path. State2-State5 deliberately not built (multi-state broadcast out of scope).
configurations.name: SC_SLED_VehicleRegistrationQuery

configurations.description: VehicleStolenQuery -- QV.VM (VIN + make), QV.P (plate). Synthetic suffixes: metadata declares QV for both. BUILT BY ROB DECISION 2026-09-14 despite the devdoc listing QV among the data-mined NCIC transactions.
configurations.name: SC_SLED_VehicleStolenQuery

configurations.description: DriverLicenseQuery -- QWDQ (name + sex + DOB), DQ (OLN). Both keyRefs are declared distinctly in metadata. State2-State5 deliberately not built.
configurations.name: SC_SLED_DriverLicenseQuery

configurations.description: DriverRegistrationQuery -- DQ.RN (name + DOB), DQ.RO (OLN). ISOLATED from DriverLicenseQuery with DR-suffixed fieldIds AND synthetic keyRefs: metadata gives BOTH transactions a keyRef of DQ, and their OLN combos have IDENTICAL mandatory sets, which ordering cannot separate. Note SexCode is OPTIONAL here and MANDATORY on the DriverLicense name combo -- the devdoc lists it as mandatory for both; metadata is field authority.
configurations.name: SC_SLED_DriverRegistrationQuery

configurations.description: WantedPersonQuery -- QWA.NCIC, QWA.OCA, QWA.P, QWA.VM, QWA.N. All five alternatives declare keyRef QWA in metadata, so all five carry synthetic suffixes. Cross-entity: two combos search by vehicle identifiers on the Person entity. Identifier-priority guardrails keep the broad name search behind the unique handles.
configurations.name: SC_SLED_WantedPersonQuery

configurations.description: GunQuery -- QG (serial number, with make/model/caliber optional). Single metadata combination.
configurations.name: SC_SLED_GunQuery

configurations.description: ArticleSingleQuery -- QA. BOTH serial number and type code are mandatory in metadata, and there are no optionals, so the officer must supply both.
configurations.name: SC_SLED_ArticleSingleQuery

configurations.description: BoatQuery -- QBBQ.H (hull), QBBQ.R (registration number). The metadata expresses Hull OR Registration as a Choice nested under Set, which METADATA_REFERENCE.txt renders as an EMPTY required set; both branches come from the raw XML. Hull>Registration guardrail on the registration path.
configurations.name: SC_SLED_BoatQuery

configurations.description: AdministrativeMessage -- AM. Free text to up to five destination ORIs; the only non-search transaction SC declares as Basic. STATUS: HYPOTHESIS -- first non-entity surface in the portfolio; whether the platform renders a sixth targetEntity is unverified, so it is ordered LAST and the first import must confirm the other five still render. Metadata makes only FreeText mandatory while the devdoc marks DestinationCode mandatory; metadata is field authority, so the destination codes are optional and the label carries the expectation.
configurations.name: SC_SLED_AdministrativeMessage
